items.raw_excerpt: Medieval life is violent and the diet is spare, but the absence of doomscrolling makes it more than worthwhile, live-action role-players say.
items.summary_en: A group of people in Australia dress up and act as people from medieval times. They say this hobby helps them escape social media and meet real friends. The simple food and rough life do not stop them from having fun.

items.raw_excerpt: A Vietnamese high school student and his friends have developed an AI system that can decipher doctors' handwriting and digitize medical records, with Amazon providing US$35,000 to support its further development.
items.summary_en: A high school student in Vietnam built an AI system that reads doctors' messy handwriting and turns medical records into digital text. Amazon gave his team US$35,000 to help them develop it further.

items.raw_excerpt: Long-term residents of Villa Las Estrellas, a Chilean settlement on Antarctica's King George Island, must have their appendix removed before moving in because the nearest major hospital is more than 1,000 km away.
items.summary_en: Villa Las Estrellas is a small Chilean settlement on King George Island in Antarctica. Before moving in, every long-term resident must have their appendix removed. The nearest major hospital is over 1,000 km away, so there is no time for emergency surgery.

items.raw_excerpt: There are some Dutch words which all foreigners in the Netherlands seem to adopt as soon as they get off the plane, train or ferry. So here’s a list of some of them. Lesson 63: First words Lekker: means tasty and is the first Dutch word everyone learns. Lekker describes just about everything which is positive: from a lekker broodje with lekker weer and lekkere sex. Borrel: For some reason, we don’t go for drinks; we always have a borrel....
items.summary_en: A Dutch news column lists ten words that newcomers in the Netherlands quickly learn. It covers everyday favorites like lekker for anything tasty or good, and borrel for casual drinks with friends.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드에 새로 온 사람들이 금방 익히는 네덜란드어 열 단어를 소개한 칼럼이다. 맛있거나 좋은 것을 뜻하는 레커, 친구와 가볍게 마시는 술자리를 뜻하는 보렐 같은 일상 단어를 다룬다.
items.title_en: 10 Dutch words every foreigner in the Netherlands picks up
